name: HCapital
facts: New Ideas I and New Ideas II
position: HCapital is a Portuguese private-equity and venture-capital manager. Its venture side invests through the New Ideas I and New Ideas II funds, with a portfolio concentrated in energy, e-mobility, logistics and industrial software, alongside AI automation and digital identity.
lede: I'm a Lisbon-based Product & RevOps manager. Most of your venture portfolio is hardware-heavy, but the software layer on top, from Automaise and LOQR to Routal and Evio, is exactly where I work: product, data and the revenue engine.
summary: HCapital's companies build physical infrastructure, from charging networks to second-life batteries, and almost all of them depend on software to win customers and run operations. That's where I come in. I've spent nine years in tech building B2B and B2C products, including location and routing tech at HEROW and identity at Pi Network, and setting up the CRM and customer-success systems that let B2B companies scale. Your AI, identity and logistics-software companies match my background directly.

reasons.title: Location and routing tech
reasons.body: I was PM on HEROW's geofencing SDK and platform. Routal, Dingoo and Evio live on location data, routing and mobile apps.

reasons.title: AI automation and identity
reasons.body: Automaise and LOQR serve banks and insurers with AI and digital onboarding. I scaled KYC to 14M+ users and shipped LLM features with evals and guardrails.

reasons.title: Software on top of hardware
reasons.body: For energy and e-mobility companies, the app, the data and the B2B sales motion decide adoption. I can own that layer without needing to own the hardware.

vc_notes.thesis: Energy and industrial focus; my overlap is the software, AI and identity part of the portfolio.
vc_notes.stage: Investment stage isn't stated; the portfolio spans early-stage and growing companies.
